title: The Fall of Saramund
author: Collegium of Seven Lenses
pages: Before Ostrevane, before the Burning Summer, the north was Saramund, the High Kingdom. Its folk were tall and built tall: doors three men high, towers the Reach still cannot bury.
In the First Night, when the sky broke and the dead walked, Saramund's Tall King, Aldemar, heard the Starwrights say the Dawn had fallen into the Hollow. He swore he would bring her home.
He opened the Sealed Keeps his fathers built over the ways into the Hollow, and marched in with his whole people behind him: knights, farmers, children, carts of stone to build a road.
None came back as they went. The Hollowed who walk our fields at night, tall, mute and black, are said to be them. They carry stones from place to place, as if still building that road home.
Do not look into their eyes. Not because they are wicked, but because they remember being looked at by a king, and cannot bear that it was not him. Leave them their stones.
